results.controlIntent: a. Identify and document [Assignment: organization-defined duties of individuals requiring separation]; and b. Define system access authorizations to support separation of duties.

judgment.rationale: The IAM execution role attached to the churn-predictor-endpoint (arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/SageMakerExecutionRole-Generic) demonstrates a complete absence of separation of duties. Two policies are attached: (1) 'OverlyBroadS3' grants s3:* on all resources (*), explicitly noted as overly broad with unscoped training-bucket write access and cross-account access; (2) 'SageMakerFull' grants sagemaker:* on all resources (*). These wildcard policies collapse all ML lifecycle duties — data ingestion, model training, deployment, inference, and administration — into a single execution identity. AC-5 requires (a) identifying and documenting duties requiring separation and (b) defining access authorizations to enforce that separation. Neither requirement is met: there is no evidence of duty decomposition, and the access authorizations actively undermine separation by granting unrestricted SageMaker and S3 permissions to an inference endpoint role. A conformant configuration would scope the inference role to only the actions needed at runtime (e.g., sagemaker:InvokeEndpoint, s3:GetObject on specific inference-input buckets) and use separate roles for training, deployment, and administration.
gaps: No organizational duty-separation documentation was retrievable (e.g., RACI matrix, role-definition policy documents) — human attestation needed to confirm whether duties are at least documented even if not technically enforced.

No evidence of additional SCPs (Service Control Policies) or permission boundaries that might further restrict the role at the AWS Organizations level — these could partially compensate but were not available via the collector.
No evidence of whether separate IAM roles exist for training vs. deployment vs. inference workflows — only the endpoint execution role was assessed.

policies.note: Overly broad — training bucket writes and cross-account access not scoped
